turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail: Unfortunately, we cannot bring the delivery date forward. Your order will be delivered within the time slot communicated when you placed it. The driver may call shortly before delivery or if you are absent.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Log in to your Tediber account and open the “Mes commandes” section. Your tracking number and link appear once the order leaves the warehouse and is handed to the carrier.

If you do not see a tracking link there, please send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when placing the order so I can check the shipment.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
Compensation for a delivery delay is not automatic. Each situation needs to be reviewed based on the order and the circumstances of the delay.

Please send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, the phone number used when placing the order, and the scheduled delivery date. Also let me know whether the order has now been delivered.
